subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with `includeDetails: true` be suppressed before mutating-tool handling, including full-verbose, cron, and heartbeat cases?
rationale: Current tests intentionally surface some detail-mode exec failures, while the PR's one-line change does not reach mutating exec/bash paths, so the correct repair depends on the desired user-facing warning policy.

options.title: Clarify Policy Then Rework Branch
options.body: Decide which includeDetails contexts stay visible, then move or preserve the exec-like suppression branch and update regression tests to match.

options.title: Suppress All Exec-Like Warnings
options.body: Accept the contributor's direction, but require moving suppression before mutating handling plus proof that important failure details are not needed in those contexts.

options.title: Preserve Detail-Mode Warnings
options.body: Keep current detail visibility for full-verbose, cron, and heartbeat paths and narrow or close the linked issue instead of merging this branch.

recommendation.title: Clarify Policy Then Rework Branch
recommendation.body: Decide which includeDetails contexts stay visible, then move or preserve the exec-like suppression branch and update regression tests to match.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent history signal for the warning-policy and tool-mutation paths involved in the decision.
